# UI image decoder

`stb_image.h` from https://github.com/nothings/stb (stb_image v2.30).
Downloaded 2026-09-29. SHA256:
`594c2fe35d49488b4382dbfaec8f98366defca819d916ac95becf3e75f4200b3`.
The embedded header carries its MIT/public-domain dual license.

Compiled only for PNG and memory input. Game assets come from the paired
Sunshine server, with bounded encoded responses, checked dimensions and
a six-entry menu-scoped cache released before streaming.
